title: 2027 KBO FA 시장 프리뷰
premise: 원태인·구자욱·홍창기·최지훈·박동원이 한꺼번에 FA 자격을 얻는다. 한 명이 움직이면 시장 전체가 흔들린다.
angle: 이름값이 아니라 보상 규정과 샐러리캡이 계약을 정한다 — 백억짜리 선수의 실제 영입 비용은 백억이 아니다

beats.what: 노시환 307억을 기준선으로 놓고, 이번 겨울 나올 다섯 명을 부른다
일정, 우선협상기간 폐지, 보상등급 A/B/C, 외부 FA 3명 제한
삼성 — 원태인과 구자욱을 동시에 잡을 수 있는가. 샐러리캡
홍창기의 출루 가치와 최지훈의 중견수 희소성
포수는 대체가 가장 어렵다. 한 명이 움직이면 연쇄가 시작된다
같은 선수를 두고 평가가 갈리는 이유 — 기준이 다를 뿐이다
가능한 전개 세 갈래. 진행 중인 협상이 아니다
세 자리로 정리하고 댓글 질문으로 닫는다

sources.name: KBO 2026년 FA 승인 선수 명단 공시
KBO, FA 자격 선수 명단 공시 (2025-11-05)

people.name: 원태인
people.look: a round boyish face with full soft cheeks - the roundness and youth are the defining trait - with large gentle eyes and very thick dark eyebrows that dominate the face; faint double eyelids, short slightly tousled black hair, a Korean man in his mid-20s, sturdy with broad shoulders

people.name: 구자욱
people.look: a long narrow face with high cheekbones and a clean straight jawline - the elongated face is the defining trait - with narrow elongated eyes and thin straight brows; short black hair, a Korean man in his early 30s, tall and lean with long limbs and narrow shoulders

people.name: 홍창기
people.look: a broad square jaw that dominates the face - the wide squared jawline is the defining trait - with large eyes under distinct double eyelids, thick dark brows and a high straight nose; full lips, a flat serious expression, short black hair with volume on top, a Korean man in his early 30s, big with wide shoulders and a thick neck

people.name: 최지훈
people.look: a narrow tapered face ending in a sharply pointed chin, with hollow cheeks and prominent cheekbones - the pointed chin is the defining trait - with small narrow sharp eyes and dark angular brows; thin lips, a Korean man in his late 20s, slim and light with a thin neck
people.tell: a red headband worn across the forehead

people.name: 박동원
people.look: a broad heavy face with a thick wide jaw and visible stubble - the heavy breadth of the face is the defining trait - with small narrow eyes, dark brows, a wide nose and a large mouth; short black hair, a Korean man in his mid-30s, powerfully built with a thick neck
people.tell: full catcher's gear - chest protector and leg guards - and a black headband
